name: Immich without machine learning
description: Self-hosted photo and video storage. This does not include the machine learning part.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Db password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-immich-without-machine-learning application
services:
  # Main Immich Server service configuration
  immich-server:
    container_name: immich-server # Name of the running container
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/immich-server:v3.1.0@sha256:b434cb9287eea1471c9974845914d4dd328c9c2d652e446ed4930f99944f0ceb # Image to be used
    # extends:
    #   file: hwaccel.transcoding.yml
    #   service: cpu # set to one of [nvenc, quicksync, rkmpp, vaapi, vaapi-wsl] for accelerated transcoding
    ports: # Mapping ports from the host OS to the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:2283"
    volumes: # Mounting directories for persistent data storage
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/upload:/usr/src/app/upload
    environment: # Setting environment variables
      DB_HOSTNAME: immich-postgres
      DB_USERNAME: casaos
      DB_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_DB_PASSWORD}
      DB_DATABASE_NAME: immich
      DB_PORT: "5432"
      REDIS_HOSTNAME: immich-redis
    depends_on: # Dependencies to ensure the order of service startup
      - redis
      - database
    restart: unless-stopped # Policy to restart unless stopped
  # Configuration for Redis service
  redis:
    container_name: immich-redis # Name of the running container
    image: redis:6.2.20-alpine@sha256:2185e741f4c1e7b0ea9ca1e163a3767c4270a73086b6bbea2049a7203212fb7f # patched for CVE-2025-49844
    restart: always # Policy to always restart the container if it stops
  # Configuration for Database service
  database:
    container_name: immich-postgres # Name of the running container
    image: ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres:14-vectorchord0.3.0-pgvectors0.2.0@sha256:c570d9e1c2494f65d2a0a379a7f6df66e8441964254a30aa62cc58e8ebf1dee0 # Image to be used
    environment: # Setting environment variables
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_DB_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_USER: casaos
      POSTGRES_DB: immich
      PG_DATA: /var/lib/postgresql/data
      # Uncomment the DB_STORAGE_TYPE: 'HDD' var if your database isn't stored on SSDs
      # DB_STORAGE_TYPE: 'HDD'
    volumes: # Mounting directories for persistent data storage
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    restart: always # Policy to always restart the container if it stops
